chunks: NEAR HAS COME the reckoning for men, but they turn away in remissness.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the proximity of the Day of Judgment and human heedlessness?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the suddenness of the Hour, serving as a warning against the spiritual complacency (ghafalah) that distracts humanity from their ultimate accountability. It highlights the contrast between the objective reality of the approaching reckoning and the subjective ignorance of those who turn away, a theme frequently echoed in the description of the Day of Judgment.
